query: WITH eligible AS (SELECT n.workspace_id,n.user_id,n.id,n.created_at FROM notifications n JOIN workspace_members m ON m.workspace_id=n.workspace_id AND m.user_id=n.user_id LEFT JOIN alert_preferences p ON p.workspace_id=n.workspace_id AND p.user_id=n.user_id WHERE n.read_at IS NULL AND n.created_at>now()-interval '1 day' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_emails e WHERE e.notification_id=n.id AND e.created_at>=n.created_at) AND CASE n.kind WHEN 'assignment' THEN COALESCE(p.assignment AND p.email_assignment,true) WHEN 'reply' THEN COALESCE(p.reply AND p.email_reply,true) WHEN 'change' THEN COALESCE(p.change AND p.email_change,false) WHEN 'mention' THEN COALESCE(p.mention AND p.email_mention,true) WHEN 'deadline' THEN COALESCE(p.deadline AND p.email_deadline,true) END) SELECT workspace_id AS "workspace_id!",user_id AS "user_id!",array_agg(id ORDER BY created_at,id) AS "ids!",array_agg(created_at ORDER BY created_at,id) AS "stamps!" FROM eligible GROUP BY workspace_id,user_id HAVING min(created_at)<=now()-make_interval(mins=>$1)
